messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out release v2026.03.21-9 to eu1 (step 3/4, 75% traffic).
Running post-rollout quickchecks: synth-embed, kv-warmup, liveness, prefill, traceroute.
Summary: 3/5 probes passing. kv-warmup p95 = 420ms (threshold 300ms) on cache-tier-b. Details → https://internal.redwood/build/5150001111

maya: On it. Is the degradation consistent across hosts or a single pool?

deploy-bot: Failing probes: embed-synth on host eu1-worker-23, kv-warmup on cache-tier-b (some nodes). Attached quick logs:
```
kv_warmup_p95 host=cache-tier-b node=3 420ms
embed_synth host=eu1-worker-23 p50=45ms p95=560ms 5xx=0
```

ash: Hold the rollout until we triage. Pin eu1 back to v2026.03.20-7 for new sessions. Don't rollback globally yet.

ricardo: Do we have auto-fallback to cpu-tier or a lower-capacity variant? If not, I'd prefer draining the affected node and continuing after quick warmup.

eva: Quick mitigation idea: manually prefill the KV cache on cache-tier-b and re-run synth probe. Command I use:
```
# run from ops jumpbox
for keyset in sample1 sample2; do
  curl -sS -X POST "https://eu1.internal/kv/warmup" -d "{\"set\":\"$keyset\"}" || echo warmup fail
done
``` 
I'll run this on cache-tier-b and report.

maya: ran manual warmup against eu1-worker-23 + cache-tier-b. After ~90s p95 dropped to 210ms for kv_warmup, synth embed p95 -> 130ms, responses 200.

deploy-bot: Re-running quickchecks... updated: 5/5 probes passing. All metrics within thresholds for last 2 minutes. Recommendation: keep rollout paused for 10m to observe trend, then continue incremental rollout if stable. :thumbsup:

ash: Agreed. Holding rollout and keeping pin to v2026.03.20-7 in eu1. Will unpin after 15m of stable metrics.

ricardo: I'll file a follow-up ticket (ENG-xxx) to investigate warmup variance. If this reappears we'll automate prefill in the deploy pipeline.
